Accelerate.text: You may pay 1 energy and a Fury rune as an additional cost to have me enter ready.

Action.text: Play on your turn or in showdowns.

Ambush.text: You may play me as a [Reaction] to a battlefield where you have units.

Backline.text: I must be assigned combat damage last.

Burn N.text: Put the top N cards of your Main Deck into your trash.

Deflect.text: Opponents must pay a rune of any color to choose me with a spell or ability.

Deflect N.text: Opponents must pay a rune of any color to choose me with a spell or ability.

Deploy.text: Play this only to a battlefield. When an opponent holds here, kill this.

Disarm.text: When I attack, give an enemy unit here -1 might this turn.

Disarm N.text: When I attack, give an enemy unit here -N might this turn.

Ganking.text: I can move from battlefield to battlefield.

Hidden.text: Hide now for a rune of any color to react with later for 0 energy.

Hunt.text: When I conquer or hold, gain 1 XP.

Hunt N.text: When I conquer or hold, gain N XP.

Predict.text: Look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.

Predict N.text: Look at the top N cards of your Main Deck. Recycle any of them and put the rest back in any order.

Reaction.text: Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.

Tank.text: I must be assigned combat damage first.

Temporary.text: Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.

Unique.text: Your deck can have only 1 card with this name.

Vision.text: When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.

Weaponmaster.text: When you play me, you may [Equip] one of your Equipment to me for a rune of any color less, even if it's already attached.
